decisions.dependency: Stage 2 scientific-skeleton freeze and valid predecessor link.
decisions.forbidden_premature_selection: Do not select seeds, checkpoint hashes, or phase labels using follow-up student, circuit, or endpoint outcomes.

decisions.dependency: Canonical teacher registry and per-seed phase classification.
decisions.forbidden_premature_selection: Do not choose definitive phase landmarks using follow-up distillation, circuit, or endpoint effects.

decisions.dependency: Technical student implementation and benchmarking; reviewed by Alex before freeze.
decisions.forbidden_premature_selection: Do not choose architecture or initialization from observed phase, condition, circuit, or endpoint effects.

decisions.decision_family: Student replication, attempt cap, replacement and minimum eligibility
decisions.dependency: Technical student-training evidence; joint Stage 11 freeze with Alex.
decisions.forbidden_premature_selection: Do not tune planned initializations, attempt caps, replacement, or minimum eligible counts to observed scientific effects.

decisions.dependency: Shared trainer implementation and technical benchmarking.
decisions.forbidden_premature_selection: Do not tune hard-training loss, optimizer, schedule, stopping rule, or attempt budget to endpoint effects.

decisions.decision_family: Soft target, loss, temperature, training and eligibility
decisions.forbidden_premature_selection: Do not choose the final soft target, loss, temperature, training settings, tolerance, or eligibility rule from observed scientific effects.

decisions.decision_family: Fidelity implementation details, threshold and precision
decisions.dependency: Centred-logit fidelity implementation and technical calibration.
decisions.forbidden_premature_selection: Do not select implementation details, threshold, denominator guard, or numerical precision to sharpen phase or student contrasts.

decisions.decision_family: Endpoint 2 component cap, overlap rule and cutoff
decisions.dependency: Packing implementation and discovery-method interface validation.
decisions.forbidden_premature_selection: Do not select component cap, overlap metric, or cutoff from observed multiplicity, phase, or condition effects.

decisions.decision_family: Discovery roster, method versions and native budgets
decisions.dependency: Discovery adapters and per-method technical benchmarking.
decisions.forbidden_premature_selection: Do not add, remove, version-select, or budget discovery methods based on scientific outcome direction.

decisions.dependency: Exact-evaluation ledger and discovery interfaces; interface review by Austin.
decisions.forbidden_premature_selection: Do not tune the common exact-mask-evaluation allowance to rescue or suppress particular scientific cells.

decisions.decision_family: Primary phase contrasts, cell summary and missing-cell rule
decisions.dependency: Frozen eligibility semantics and synthetic-fixture analysis implementation; joint review.
decisions.forbidden_premature_selection: Do not choose contrasts, cell summaries, minimum-cell handling, or unresolved-cell treatment after inspecting definitive scientific effects.

decisions.decision_family: Required analysis tables, figures and manifests
decisions.forbidden_premature_selection: Do not add, remove, or promote required outputs according to which scientific results appear strongest.

decisions.decision_family: Production concurrency, isolation and merge rule
decisions.forbidden_premature_selection: Do not let worker count, threading, isolation, or merge topology change scientific estimands, eligibility, or result inclusion.
Do not shrink or expand definitive production scope according to observed scientific outcomes.
